A_idiosyncratic_alt_premium: Makarov-Schoar: premia have a large common (country / capital-control) component; the coin-specific part is local demand for that coin. For the 16 altcoins: ip = alt kimchi premium - BTC kimchi premium (same hour 23:00 UTC, same FX); z = 30-day z (min 20); cross-section: long the 4 highest z, short the 4 lowest, 0.125 each, >= 10 coins, next day; perps 5 bp + funding. Added to v8 as a new sleeve
B_bubble_reversal: Eom: a high kimchi premium WITH high Korean trading volume marks a speculative bubble. For the 16 altcoins: kimchi z > 1 (Gen247 z) AND Upbit turnover share z > 1 (share = Upbit daily USD turnover / Binance perp quote volume; z = (7-day mean share - 90-day mean) / 90-day sd) -> short 0.1 the next day. Added to v8 as a new sleeve (it offsets v8's alt-kimchi long in bubble cases)
